items.statement: Promoter sold 75,000 shares after warrant conversion; no further dilution expected
items.quote: there was a converted allotted warrant and the promoter sold some 75,000 shares in the open market.

items.statement: Management confirms no dilution going forward from promoter
items.quote: No, there will be no dilution going forward.

items.statement: Free cash flow generation of INR 254 crores in Q4 2025, a 56% year-on-year improvement
items.quote: One of the highlights has been the strong focus on free cash flow generation, which, as you can see, we have been able to bring in INR 254 crores into the kitty.

items.statement: Promoter sold 75,000 shares after warrant conversion; no further dilution planned
items.quote: No, there will be no dilution going forward.

items.statement: Operating cash generation improved by over INR 2.2 billion versus 2024 and overall cash improvement of roughly INR 750 million rupees
items.quote: Fifth, cash position. Cash and equivalent strengthened sharply year-on-year with operating cash generation improving by over INR 2.2 billion versus 2024 and an overall cash improvement of roughly INR 750 million rupees.

items.statement: Cash and bank balances grew from INR 62 crore to INR 226 crore, nearly four times in a single year
items.quote: Cash and balance grew from INR 62 crore to INR 226 crores. Nearly four times in a single year.

items.statement: Improved billing and collections, reduced unbilled revenue as projects move towards billing milestones, and strengthened advance receipt on new projects
items.quote: Sixth, the working capital. We improved billing and collections, reduced unbilled revenue as project move towards billing milestones, and strengthened advance receipt on new projects.

items.statement: MD & CEO Rishi Gupta named in DGGI investigation into alleged GST evasion by program managers; arrested 27 Feb 2026
items.quote: Officials of the Directorate General of GST Intelligence, DGGI Hyderabad, in connection with investigation into alleged GST evasion by certain program managers associated with the bank, have named Mr. Gupta in the matter.

items.statement: Board constituted committee and appointed CFO Ketan Merchant as interim head on 27 Feb 2026
items.quote: A special Board meeting was convened on February 27, 2026, where the Board formally requested that I oversee day-to-day functioning of the bank during this interim period to ensure seamless continuity until further decisions are taken or Mr. Gupta resumes office.

items.statement: Bank proactively engaged RBI, SEBI, I4C, FIU and stock exchanges; no impact on SFB plans per disclosure
items.quote: We have proactively engaged all the regulators, whether it's RBI, SEBI, I4C, FIU, etc. For our other stakeholders, we've informed the stock exchange and issued necessary public disclosures during the last two days on a progressive basis.

items.statement: Customer balances ~INR 2,250 cr on 26 Feb 2026, intact and higher as of call date
items.quote: Customer balances on Feb 26 , 2026, stood at approximately INR2,250 crores and today as I speak, it stands intact and more.

items.statement: Daily average CASA openings ~10,000; throughput ~INR 1,300 cr/day over last three days, in line with average
items.quote: Just to provide some statistical data , our daily average CASA opening numbers are maintained at around 10,000 and our throughput remains in the range of INR1,300 crores per day.

items.statement: Three program managers under investigation account for 8-10% of throughput; they operate across multiple banks
items.quote: I would say that these three people who do business would be in the range of about 8 % to 10% of the overall throughput for the year

items.statement: Program managers overall contribute ~80% of throughput this quarter; payment aggregators ~15-20%
items.quote: The program manager throughput will be about 80% in this quarter.

items.statement: Bank has no business with the three program managers after RMG ban; unequivocal no
items.quote: Ashwini, the answer to your question is no. Unequivocal no, we are not doing any such business whatsoever in any capacity.

items.statement: Rishi Gupta not a director on any unlisted company; no personal interest in program managers per records
items.quote: Mr. Rishi Gupta is not a director on the board of any unlisted company.

items.statement: INR 10 cr ad hoc GST payment in Nov 2025 was for bank's own compliance, unrelated to current case; not a penalty
items.quote: The INR10 crores is not a penalty. So the INR10 crores was an ad hoc payment made for the GST which will be subsequently adjusted against our any normal GST liability.

items.statement: GST authorities sought data for current financial year only; bank provided information on 9 Feb and 26 Feb 2026
items.quote: So the bank did receive a request for providing certain transaction information on 9th February from the GST officials, which we were provided by the bank, timely provided by the bank. On 26th Feb again they requested certain more details or more informat ion for the program managers/merchants in question.

items.statement: Dividend per share proposed at INR 123 for FY25, up 5% versus 2024, with interim already distributed and final to be approved in May-June.
items.quote: Regarding the dividend proposal and based on the yesterday Board meeting, so the proposal to the general assembly will be plus 5% versus 2024. So in terms of earnings per share so it's INR 142 and the dividend per share will be INR 123.

items.statement: Operational cash flow is positive at INR70-75 crores year-to-date despite P&L loss from accounting adjustment

items.statement: Operating cash flows have been negative historically due to industry nature and margin pressure but improving significantly this year
items.quote: It is partly a nature of the industry, the nature of our assignments. The competition has been pretty tough when it comes to margins now, especially in case of the PMC assignments that are there.

items.statement: No audit qualifications in limited review report; clean auditor report justifies no structural problems
items.quote: There have been no items of qualification also that have been mentioned by the auditors. It is a clean report and that itself justifies that there is no problem that has been going on in the company.

items.statement: Management strengthened internal controls, hired senior finance talent, and building leadership pipeline to improve governance after accounting adjustment and debarment issues
items.quote: We have strengthened our internal control systems. We have hired very strong accounting finance through -- be it SAP accounting, be it hiring from the bigger companies and further management is getting involved in creating second line, third line leaders also, so that there is stronger governance internally.

items.statement: Interest cost savings of 30-35 crore expected relative to previous year, improving cash flow

items.quote: So, this quarter would give us maybe, yes last quarter, we had a little bit of pressure in terms of our working capital. And this quarter, significantly it will reduce from the last quarter.

items.quote: Subsequently, closure of the quarter, received a majority of the receivables, and the working capital pressure is now eased. As on, if we see, as on date, we are in a comfortable position and receivables have started getting back.

items.quote: Let me clarify that, the promoters have not sold a single share and there is no intent of selling single shares at all. But you can see the holding percentage coming down because of the ESOP issue which has come up.

items.quote: But all these 10 people are still together, and these 10 people together hold around 53%-54% of the company.

items.statement: ESOP issuance caused promoter holding percentage to decline optically
items.quote: If you can go through our DRHP and other things, we spoke about the ESOP which has coming out and employees have got fresh shares and hence the holding of the promoters will optically come down.

items.statement: Q3 FY26 operating cash flow was INR 129 crore, up 16% year-over-year, driven by a 14-day reduction in DSO from 92 to 78 days.
items.quote: Now moving over to cash, we generated INR 129 crore of cash from operations, which was 16% higher than the same period last year. This was primarily driven by 14 days reduction in days of sales outstanding from 92 days in the last fiscal to 78 days in the current fiscal.

items.statement: Nine-month FY26 operating cash flow was INR 108 crore versus INR 120 crore last year; adjusting for IPO expenses and GST refund timing of INR 57 crore, it would be INR 165 crore, up 38% year-on-year.
items.quote: For the first nine months of fiscal 2026, cash from operations came in at INR 108 crore versus INR 120 crores at the same time last year. IPO -related expenses to be recovered and GST refund timing impacted the cash from operations adversely by INR 57 crore. Adjusting for this, cash from operations for the nine months would be INR 165 crore, which represents 38% year-on-year growth.
